image_description: A close-up portrait of a person wearing a voluminous, curly white wig. The wig covers the top and sides of the head but appears to slip or fit poorly on the left side (viewer's right), revealing the person's forehead and hairline. The person has a slight smile and is looking directly at the camera. The background is dark and out of focus.
